Name: Custom Hot Springs Regeneration Rate
Author: Teoshen
Description:
Do you like the feeling of a hot bath after a long day of work, but worry about the balance of having such amenities so close to home?

Or, do you really hate being short on energy and want to take quick, refreshing dips that refill your stamina in seconds to chop more trees?

In either case, this mod allows you to adjust the stamina and health regeneration rate in the farm cave hot springs, from 10% to 200%.


[url=https://github.com/Teoshen/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/HotSpringStamina]Source Code[/url]

Manifest.Name: Hot Spring Regeneration
Manifest.Description: Gives an option to reduce or increase the amount of stamina and health regenerated by the hot springs.
Manifest.Author: Teoshen
